I am a Computer Science student at the University of Waterloo, Class of 2030. My interests lie broadly in AI coding agents and software engineering, especially the ways AI can support developers and how software systems can be made more reliable.

Through UR2PhD, I am currently examining reuse patterns in the GitSkills dataset. I will also join Professor Ho Chen's group at the University of Hong Kong, working with Huaien Zhang. That work may involve compiler testing and analyzing GitHub issues.

Updates

  • Oct 2026: Studying skill reuse in the GitSkills dataset through UR2PhD.
  • Upcoming: Joining a research group at the University of Hong Kong; possible work includes compiler testing and GitHub issue analysis.

Research Interests

I am broadly interested in AI for software engineering. In particular, I want to understand how AI coding agents can assist with real development tasks, how their reliability can be evaluated, and how software testing and program analysis can improve the tools developers use.

  • AI coding agents and developer workflows
  • Software engineering and AI for software development
  • Software testing, program analysis, and reliability
